fields.description: The Orchard is the estate-villa collection at Sobha City in Abu Dhabi. Four-, five- and six-bedroom homes are arranged over several levels, with private outdoor space and larger family rooms. Its individual drawings distinguish saleable home area from plot size, so the two figures should be compared separately.
amenities: Swimming pool in illustrated villa types

overview: The four-bedroom Type A includes a ground-floor guest room, two first-floor bedrooms and a further bedroom above. Five- and six-bedroom drawings provide different room arrangements and service spaces. Mirrored layouts retain their own plot schedules; a mirror suffix does not establish an identical plot.
research.locationNote: Within Sobha City, Abu Dhabi. Property Finder places the collection in Al Bahya, also written Al Bahia. Confirm the exact villa plot or tower position on its own approved plan; community travel times are not unit-specific measurements.
research.priceNote: The dedicated developer page currently advertises AED 9.70m, subject to inventory. Property Finder retains an approximately AED 9.1m launch reference. Neither figure is a quotation for an identified available villa.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 20% at launch, 40% during construction and 40% on handover. No dated developer-issued schedule was located in the project page or reviewed brochure. This is an attributed launch reference; obtain the current instalments, fees and deadlines in writing.
research.handoverNote: The project brochure expressly prints ACD December 2029. Property Finder reports the same month. ACD is an anticipated completion reference; the selected sale agreement governs delivery.
